**Congo, The Democratic Republic of the: how applications changed.** The extract records 1,263,884 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 109,255 in 2017, compared with 57,409 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 11% lower than in 2019 (64,694). Applications in 2025 were 5.2% higher than in 2024 (54,565). In 2025, the leading destinations were France (19,510; 34%), Uganda (5,508; 9.6%), United Rep. of Tanzania (5,073; 8.8%). France received 34% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 10% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 47%, across 40,703 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 19% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 11.9 percentage points lower than in 2024 (58%).
